source: PC Night of the Hunter: the dog whistle is an inventory item from the hall's chest of drawers, used from the kitchen while the neighbour is at the record player (Steam guide 2584421942; Badinfos' run, lap 2). The mobile has no whistle — its Dog is a Zone06 Alerter.

InventoryItems.DescriptionString: Only the dog hears it. The neighbour hears the dog.
